text: Giving a talk at ROSCon ES 2026 in Valencia! I will present the state of RoboRacer (scaled autonomous racing) at the University of Alcalá.
🏆 TokenGraph3D wins the Best Paper Runner-Up Award in the Archival Track of the DriveX Workshop at ECCV 2026 in Malmö!
Attended the ELLIS Summer School on Autonomous Driving (SSAD) 2026 in Barcelona, four intensive days of keynotes, panels and poster sessions on perception, world models and end-to-end driving.

Attended the Fundamentos de IA Summer School at Universidad Internacional de Andalucía, hosted in my hometown, Baeza. A great week on generative models and AI applications in health, computer vision and language, completed with the top grade (10/10).
🏆 TokenGraph3D accepted as an oral at the DriveX Workshop at ECCV 2026! Joint work with TU Delft on emergent 3D instance segmentation from self-supervised Point Transformers.
Taught at the iRoboCity2030 Summer School on ROS 2, AI and Field Robotics in Madrid, giving a lecture on ROS 2 for scaled autonomous racing cars.
🏆 TerraSeg accepted at CVPR 2026! Honored to participate in the development of the first self-supervised, domain-agnostic model for LiDAR ground segmentation.
🏆 GaussianCaR accepted at ICRA 2026! Looking forward to presenting our work on Camera-Radar fusion using Gaussian Splatting in Vienna.
Gave a talk at ROSCon ES 2025 in Barcelona! Great to be back at the conference and spread the word about DINO models in robotics.

Participated at European Researchers' Night 2025 representing RobeSafe, where we hosted a twofold demonstration: a virtual simulation in the CARLA simulator and a live real-vehicle demo operating fully autonomously.
Started an internship at the Intelligent Vehicles Lab at TU Delft, under the supervision of Dr. Holger Caesar.
New journal paper accepted at Sensors MDPI! Check it out in the Research section below.
Started my Ph.D. at the RobeSafe Research Group of University of Alcalá, under the supervision of Prof. Luis M. Bergasa and Dr. Angel Llamazares.
